english.title: Attempt or do act preparatory to fishing for salmon in Tweed district without permission
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[attempted to fish for or take]_
(B)_[did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), preparatory to the fishing for or taking of]_

salmon in waters in the Tweed district, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), without legal right or written permission from a person having such right
english.legislation: Contrary to article 27(2) of the Scotland Act 1998 (River Tweed) Order 2006.
